payload.title: Accessing CMIP6 output with `intake`
payload.description: This workflow demonstrates how to access and query CMIP6 data using the `intake` library, focusing on data hosted by AWS and Google Cloud. It guides users through browsing the CMIP6 catalog, selecting data of interest, and concatenating experiments in time, including calendar conversions.
